request.description: Transparent pixel-art scenery atlas for a quiet low-poly mountain village RPG, EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows of 64x64 cells, 12 isolated regional props, 8 transparent pixels minimum around EVERY cell, no grid, no text, no labels. Match attached quiet-map props: muted sage, faded ochre, grey-green stone, grey-brown timber, restrained flat shapes, TWO or THREE broad colors per material, NO black outlines, NO dithering, NO individual texture speckles, no ornate details, no gradients, no baked cast shadows, no floors. Viewed orthographically from above about38degrees. ROW1 left to right: a low coiled fishing net with two simple tan floats; a pair of chunky rusty quarry wedges beside a short mallet; one broken carved grey-green stone plaque with one simple recessed rectangular motif; a pair of plain snowshoes made from muted tan wood with two wide straps. ROW2: a low cluster of three matte pale oyster shells with no pearl; two short freshly cut bamboo tubes tied with a plain tan cord; a little faded red-brown cloth windsock on a SHORT wooden bracket; a low stack of two square grain trays with coarse pale contents. ROW3: a small flat scatter of five LARGE muted ochre maple leaves; a squat unlit plain grey-brown incense pot with two thick short incense sticks; three chunky dark basalt shards with broad flat sides and no sparkle; a low rolled grey-blue survey chart tied beside a simple plain wooden measuring stick. Every object centered independently within its own cell, never crossing to another cell, base near cell y52. These are background scenery details at small scale, not glossy loot icons. No characters, buildings, scenery, border or ground.

notes: 사용자가 승인한 원정 맵 디자인 고도화. 기존 차분한 소품 원본을 스타일 참조로 사용해 한 시트 생성. 원본 픽셀은 수정하지 않고 64픽셀 셀의 투명 여백만 추출. 장식 소품으로 보상·해금·입력 규칙을 추가하지 않음.
